title: Descent of normalized Roos comparisons preserves the specified unit
statement: Fix ell,E and a scheme morphism r:S -> T. Use the ordinary pullback models [def-fix-qcqs-completion-ordinary-models] and the specified strict quotient tower, Roos functor, good representatives, completion and completion unit [def-pur-integral-derived-operations]. Suppose ordinary pullback is exact; tau and chi are natural tower and Roos isomorphisms; tau preserves the quotient augmentation; and both product coordinates of chi equal the canonical product comparison followed by tau. Suppose pullback preserves good representatives and alpha is a derived completion comparison with the prescribed representative normalization through the actual derived counit and completionComparison. Then for every H, F_r^L(eta_H) followed by alpha_H equals eta_(F_r^L H). Also, exact pullback preserving good representatives descends every natural chain Roos isomorphism chi to an alpha satisfying that representative normalization, by fully faithful precomposition with the good localization.

proof.text: The ordinary complex counit is the component of a natural transformation obtained by whiskering the total left-derived counit through the quotient factorization isomorphisms. Exactness makes it invertible because the underived complex functor inverts quasi-isomorphisms.

proof.text: Conjugate chi on good representatives by the ordinary counit and the two completionComparison isomorphisms. Fully faithful precomposition along qGood descends this natural isomorphism to alpha. The map_preimage equation, followed by its inverse comparison, gives the required representative normalization.

proof.text: A map into a mapping cocone is determined by its fst and shifted snd coordinates: compose the degreewise decomposition of its identity with the map. The given coordinates of chi and the augmentation equality identify the image of the (quotient,zero) lift with the same lift after pullback.

proof.text: Compare two natural transformations out of the ordinary derived pullback. It suffices to compare them on good representatives. Postcompose with the invertible target counit and completion comparison; use the representative equation for alpha, counit naturality and the normalizations of both completion units. Cancel the invertible postcomposition and use fully faithful precomposition by qGood.

theorem ordinaryCompletionComparison_unit
    [PreservesFiniteLimits (ordinaryPull l E r)]
    [PreservesFiniteColimits (ordinaryPull l E r)]
    (hgood : ∀ P : (Good l E T none).FullSubcategory,
      Good l E S none ((ordinaryComplexPull l E r).obj P.obj))
    (α : completion l E T none ⋙ ordinaryDerivedPull l E r ≅
      ordinaryDerivedPull l E r ⋙ completion l E S none)
    (hα : ∀ P : (Good l E T none).FullSubcategory,
      (ordinaryDerivedPull l E r).map ((completionComparison l E T none).hom.app P) ≫
          ordinaryComplexCounit l E r ((roos l E T none).obj P.obj) ≫
          DerivedCategory.Q.map (χ.hom.app P.obj) =
        α.hom.app ((qGood l E T none).obj P) ≫
          (completion l E S none).map (ordinaryComplexCounit l E r P.obj) ≫
          (completionComparison l E S none).hom.app
            ⟨(ordinaryComplexPull l E r).obj P.obj, hgood P⟩)
    (H : D l E T none) :
    (ordinaryDerivedPull l E r).map ((completionUnit l E T none).app H) ≫
        α.hom.app H =
      (completionUnit l E S none).app ((ordinaryDerivedPull l E r).obj H)
